title: Republic Services Named to 100 Best Corporate Citizens List
summary: Recognition reflects company's commitment to strong governance, ethical business practices and creating long-term value for stakeholders
body_markdown:
*Recognition reflects company's commitment to strong governance, ethical business practices and creating long-term value for stakeholders*


PHOENIX (Sept. 15, 2026) — Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG), a leader in the environmental services industry, has been named to 3BL’s 2026 100 Best Corporate Citizens list, which recognizes companies for transparency and performance across key environmental, social and governance measures.


The 100 Best Corporate Citizens list evaluates companies across a broad range of environmental, social and governance criteria, including climate and environmental stewardship, employee engagement, ethical business practices, human rights, stakeholder value creation and corporate governance. The assessment provides investors, customers and other stakeholders with an independent benchmark of how companies manage risks, create long-term value and demonstrate accountability through transparent reporting.


Republic Services is committed to creating a more sustainable world by advancing circularity, promoting decarbonization and helping customers meet their environmental commitments. With a strong focus on employee safety and development, sustainability innovation and community engagement, the company strives to deliver long-term value for customers, shareholders and the communities it serves.


Republic Services has received other notable third-party recognition during the past year, including being named to[Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies](https://worldsmostethicalcompanies.com/honorees/) list, Fortune's list of[World's Most Admired Companies](https://fortune.com/ranking/worlds-most-admired-companies/) and is certified as a[Great Place to Work](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4763947-1&h=3827927650&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2F&a=GreatPlacetoWork.com) . To view the full 2026 100 Best Corporate Citizens rankings, visit[3BL.org](https://3bl100best.com/) .


For more information about Republic Services' sustainability and ESG initiatives, visit[RepublicServices.com/Sustainability](https://www.republicservices.com/sustainability) .


**About 100 Best Corporate Citizens**
The 100 Best Corporate Citizens ranking, launched in 2009 by 3BL, tracks and recognizes environmental, social, and governance (ESG) transparency and performance among the 1,000 largest publicly traded U.S. companies in the Russell 1,000 Index. Utilizing publicly available data analyzed in partnership with ISS-Corporate, the methodology evaluates companies across multiple pillars—including climate change, employee relations, environment, governance, human rights, and stakeholders and society—without requiring formal company submissions or entry fees. For more information, please visit[3bl100best.com](https://3bl100best.com/)


**About Republic Services**
Republic Services, Inc. is a leader in the environmental services industry. Through its subsidiaries, the company provides customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, solid waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Republic's industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on its vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. For more information, please visit[RepublicServices.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4422216-1&h=507951226&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D3404937-1%26h%3D676368477%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Frepublicservices.com%252F%26a%3DRepublicServices.com&a=RepublicServices.com) .
